description: This file contains extension methods for adding JSON configuration files and streams to an IConfigurationBuilder, specifically for tenant-specific JSON configuration in OrchardCore.

classes.name: TenantJsonConfigurationExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for adding tenant-specific JSON configuration sources to IConfigurationBuilder.

methods.name: AddTenantJsonFile
methods.description: Adds a JSON configuration file to the builder with various overloads for specifying path, optionality, and reload behavior.

methods.name: AddTenantJsonStream
methods.description: Adds a JSON configuration stream to the builder.
